_comment: Committed PDK + tool defaults for the layout evidence under layout/.
This is the layout-verification sibling of sim/pdk.json -- deliberately
a SEPARATE file, per sim/pdk.json's own precedent (this repo has no
design/pdk.json; the schematic/netlist flow doesn't need a PDK install,
only xschem's own sky130 symbol library). open_pdks_commit below
matches sim/pdk.json's exactly -- both pin the same open_pdks release,
verified 2026-09-15.
variant           sky130 flavor directory used to generate/verify
every layout/ evidence directory below
open_pdks_commit  provenance pin, matches sim/pdk.json
klt_deck          the klayout-tools (`klt`) curated rule-deck name
resolved for this PDK family (--deck sky130 on
every klt drc / klt extract / klt lvs invocation
under layout/). klt's curated decks are built in --
no real open_pdks install is required to run the
layout/ chain itself, only to resolve --pdk sky130A
for `klt gen`'s own PDK-family role-layer tables.
klt_version_pin   the klt build this evidence was last generated/
verified against, from `klt version --format json`.
A provenance pin, not a hard gate -- re-verifying
with a different klt build is expected to happen
and should update this pin plus the affected
evidence directories together, mirroring
2AMLogic/sky130-trng's layout/pdk.json precedent
(this recipe's own reference, see layout/README.md).
